workflow.when: Before selected supported content enters the intended workflow
workflow.input: Canonical HTTPS URL plus actual purpose/context and bounded budget
workflow.unknown: Hold; do not treat as permission
workflow.purchase: Secure mode: POST /v1/rights/preflight -> verified offer -> unchanged official x402 signer -> AcqPath SIWX adapter -> verified report
workflow.stockPurchase: Stock mode: POST /v1/rights/preflight/x402 -> verified 0.02 USDC fresh offer -> unchanged official x402 v2 signer -> verified report; no SIWX or custom signer
workflow.modeSelection: Use secure mode when payer-signed request binding is required. Stock mode is limited to fresh Rights Preflight at 0.02 USDC on Base.
workflow.verification: Pinned Ed25519 offer/report/receipt/delivery binding via reviewed buyer client
workflow.retry: Secure mode: reuse saved payment/SIWX state. Stock mode: reuse the exact signed request and PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. Never replace a pending authorization.
workflow.duplicatePrevention: One logical ID, local lock, checkpoint before submission, same authorization on retry
